description: This Java source file defines the 'ContactAdder' Android activity, which provides a UI for users to create and add new contacts to their device's contact list, associated with a specific account. It handles UI initialization, account management, and contact creation through ContentProvider operations.

classes.name: ContactAdder
classes.description: An Android activity class that facilitates adding new contacts to the device's contact database, linked to selected accounts, with UI components for user input and account selection.

classes.name: AccountData
classes.description: A nested class representing account information, including name, type, label, and icon, used to populate account selection UI.

classes.name: AccountAdapter
classes.description: A custom ArrayAdapter for displaying account items with icons and labels in the account selection spinner.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, populates account and contact type spinners, and registers account update listener.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up by removing account update listener.

methods.name: onAccountsUpdated
methods.description: Updates the internal account list and refreshes the account spinner when system accounts change.

methods.name: updateAccountSelection
methods.description: Updates the currently selected account based on user selection in the spinner.

methods.name: createContactEntry
methods.description: Gathers data from UI fields and constructs a batch of ContentProvider operations to insert a new contact into the contacts database.

methods.name: onSaveButtonClicked
methods.description: Handles the Save button click by creating a new contact and finishing the activity.
